designBrief: Slow bar / micro-roastery in Sunset Way, Singapore. Dark, moody, chic photography treatment (verified via Instagram grid + Maps photos) with warm brass and rare ember accents; Fraunces/Work Sans type pairing; single-page, minimalist, photography-led layout. Signature element: tasting cards styled after the business's own Instagram 'Coffee Spotlight' post format. Voice is precise and unshowy about origin/process/tasting notes, warm and grateful toward regulars, faith-and-community grounded rather than hustle-culture branding.
